Set the torso and allow the arms to reach forward without rounding excessively.
Draw your elbows back and bring the handle or weight toward your torso.
Bring the elbows back without jerking the torso.
Reach the arms forward again without letting the torso lurch.

wqNPGCg.name: cable rear delt row (with rope)
steps: Connect a rope handle to a low pulley cable machine.
Face the machine from a stable stance with feet about shoulder width.
Set the torso and allow the arms to reach forward without rounding excessively.
Draw your elbows back and bring the handle or weight toward your torso.
Bring the elbows back without jerking the torso.
Reach the arms forward again without letting the torso lurch.

xNrS20v.name: barbell reverse curl
steps: Stand tall with your feet about shoulder width and hold a barbell with palms facing down.
Let the elbows do the moving while the upper arms stay put and Breathe out and curl the barbell upward, contracting your biceps.
Set the shoulders and upper arms before bending the elbows.
Curl the weight with your palms facing down, keeping the elbows close and torso still.
Keep the torso quiet and let the elbow bend lift the weight.
Lower until the elbows are nearly straight, keeping the upper arms still.

xdYPUtE.name: sissy squat
steps: Stand and set your feet about shoulder width and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Use a stable object for balance if needed.
Brace the abdomen and spread pressure across the whole foot.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Drive upward with the chest and hips rising together; keep the knees from collapsing inward.
Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent.

yWxMvB5.name: kettlebell thruster
steps: Begin by standing with your feet about shoulder width, holding a kettlebell ahead of your chest with both hands, palms facing each other.
Before moving, lower into a squat position by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up and your back straight.
Rack the weight securely and brace before dropping into the squat.
Stand from the squat and use that leg drive to press the weight overhead.
Let the leg drive start the press while keeping the ribs from flaring.
Ease back to the start before repeating.

ykHcWme.name: sled calf press on leg press
steps: Set the seat of the leg press machine so that your knees are soft when your feet are on the sled.
Set your feet about shoulder width on the sled, with your toes pointing forward.
Let the ankles move freely while the rest of the body stays quiet.
Rise through the balls of your feet, lifting the heels as high as you can without rocking.
Pause at the top without rolling the ankles outward.
Lower the heels at a measured pace before rising again.

ykUOVze.name: Machine Standing Calf Raise
steps: Set the machine to your height and stand with your feet about shoulder width.
Set your shoulders under the pads and hold onto the handles for stability.
Let the ankles move freely while the rest of the body stays quiet.
Rise through the balls of your feet, lifting the heels as high as you can without rocking.
Pause at the top without rolling the ankles outward.
Lower the heels at a measured pace before rising again.

yn8yg1r.name: dumbbell goblet squat
steps: Stand and set your feet about shoulder width, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
With your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Brace the abdomen and spread pressure across the whole foot.
Bend at the hips and knees to lower, keeping your feet grounded and knees tracking with the toes.
Drive upward with the chest and hips rising together; keep the knees from collapsing inward.
Stand fully, reset your footing and breathing, then begin the next descent.
